item.title: Burst water pipe at Riverview Senior Living in Harrison forces some residents to move
item.description: A burst pipe Monday night at Riverview Senior Living in Harrison flooded lower-level units and forced a number of residents to leave.

item.title: MLB spring training brings attention to robot umps, WBC
item.description: Just 102 days after a thrilling World Series ended with the Los Angeles Dodgers becoming the first repeat champion in a quarter century, pitchers and catchers are back on the field Tuesday as spring training begins with an initial focus on ABS and WBC.

item.title: Despite Super Bowl loss, Patriots believe they have ability to return and win more titles
item.description: Just as New England Patriots coach Mike Vrabel had done throughout his team’s surprise run to the NFL’s biggest stage, he made sure he was the first person to offer hugs to his players as they exited the field following Sunday’s Super Bowl loss to the Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: Raiders officially hire Klint Kubiak as head coach after his Super Bowl win with Seahawks
item.description: HENDERSON, Nev. — The Las Vegas Raiders made it official Monday by announcing Seattle Seahawks offensive coordinator Klint Kubiak will be their next head coach.

item.title: No. 9 Kansas beats top-ranked, previously undefeated Arizona
item.description: LAWRENCE, Kan. — Flory Bidunga had a double-double, and No. 9 Kansas defeated top-ranked and previously unbeaten Arizona, 82-78, on Monday night.

item.description: Penn Hills Library, 1037 Stotler Road, offers a variety of programs for all ages.

item.title: Riverview School Board passes student, staff safety policy in wake of ICE arrest
item.description: Riverview School Board approved Monday night a student and staff safety policy that streamlines information from various bodies.

item.title: High school roundup for Feb. 9, 2026: Shady Side Academy star Karis Thomas hits 2,000-point mark in playoff tuneup
item.description: Karis Thomas scored 25 points, becoming the 47th WPIAL girls basketball player to reach the 2,000-point mark for her career, as Shady Side Academy (20-2) tuned up for the playoffs with a 54-34 victory over Obama Academy (9-2) in nonsection girls basketball Monday night.
